pub fn to_text(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "toggle={}\nclear={}\nlaunch_at_login={}\ncolor={}\nwidth={}\ntoolbar={}\npalette={PALETTE_VERSION}\ncolors={}\nwidths={}\nrecent={}\n",
            self.toggle,
            self.clear,
            self.launch_at_login,
            self.style.color,
            self.style.width,
            self.toolbar.name(),
            join(self.palette.colors.into_iter().map(hex)),
            join(self.palette.widths.iter().map(f32::to_string)),
            join(self.recent.as_slice().iter().copied().map(hex)),
        )
    }

[workspace]

[workspace.lints.clippy]

[lints]
workspace = true

[features]
# Manual-test environment hooks (MARKULI_CONFIG_DIR, MARKULI_LAUNCH_AGENT_DIR,
# MARKULI_OPEN_SETTINGS). Off by default: release builds do not read them.
dev-hooks = []

[dependencies]
markuli-core = { path = "crates/core" }
# Window, event loop, raw handles for the native presenters. 0.31 is still beta.
winit = { version = "0.30.13", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_06"] }
# Pixel buffer type shared with the core (PixmapMut).
tiny-skia = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = ["std", "simd"] }
# Global hotkey without Accessibility permission (Carbon / RegisterHotKey).
global-hotkey = { version = "0.8", default-features = false }
# Tray icon and its Quit menu.
tray-icon = { version = "0.26", default-features = false }

[dev-dependencies]
# PNG read/write for the cursor golden images; tests only, never linked into the app.

[target.'cfg(target_os = "macos")'.dependencies]
# The macOS platform layer (overlay window, IOSurface layer, Settings window,
# clipboard) talks to AppKit directly; winit exposes none of it. The objc2-*
# crates below are the typed bindings, each limited to the classes used, with
# default features off. Replacing them means hand-written msg_send FFI.
objc2 = "0.6"
objc2-app-kit = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "NSEvent", "NSScreen", "NSResponder", "NSView", "NSWindow", "NSGraphics", "NSApplication", "NSButton", "NSControl", "NSTextField", "NSColor", "NSCell", "NSText", "NSPasteboard", "NSRunningApplication", "NSWorkspace", "NSCursor", "NSImage", "NSImageRep", "NSBitmapImageRep", "NSColorPanel", "NSPanel", "NSColorSpace"] }
objc2-foundation = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "NSGeometry", "NSArray", "NSString", "NSObject", "NSDictionary", "NSValue", "NSNotification"] }
objc2-quartz-core = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "objc2-core-foundation", "CALayer", "CATransaction"] }
objc2-core-foundation = { version = "0.3", default-features = false, features = ["std", "CFCGTypes"] }

[target.'cfg(target_os = "windows")'.dependencies]
windows-sys = { version = "0.61", default-features = false, features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_Graphics_Gdi", "Win32_System_Registry", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse", "Win32_System_DataExchange", "Win32_System_Memory", "Win32_UI_Controls_Dialogs"] }

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  macos:
    name: Universal macOS dmg
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build, package and check the 4 MB budget
        run: scripts/package-macos.sh "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-dmg
          path: dist/*.dmg
          if-no-files-found: error

  windows:
    name: Windows zip
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Build, package and check the 4 MB budget
        shell: pwsh
        run: scripts/package-windows.ps1 "$($env:GITHUB_REF_NAME -replace '^v', '')"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-zip
          path: dist/*.zip
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    needs: [macos, windows]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Create the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >
          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" artifacts/*
          --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          --title "Markuli ${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          --generate-notes

scripts/package-macos.sh::package-macos..name: package-macos.sh
scripts/package-macos.sh::package-macos..source_code:
#!/bin/bash
# Builds the unsigned universal (arm64 + x86_64) macOS dmg.
# Used by the release workflow and runnable locally:
#   scripts/package-macos.sh 0.1.0
# Output: dist/Markuli-<version>-macos-universal.dmg
set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${1:?usage: package-macos.sh <version>}"
MAX_BYTES=$((4 * 1024 * 1024)) # spec budget: artifact <= 4 MB

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --locked --target x86_64-apple-darwin

rm -rf dist
APP="dist/stage/Markuli.app"
mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS"
lipo -create -output "$APP/Contents/MacOS/markuli" \
  target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/markuli \
  target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/markuli

# LSUIElement: no Dock icon, matching the Accessory activation policy in code.
cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>CFBundleName</key><string>Markuli</string>
	<key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>Markuli</string>
	<key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>com.markuli.app</string>
	<key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>markuli</string>
	<key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
	<key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>${VERSION}</string>
	<key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>${VERSION}</string>
	<key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string>
	<key>LSUIElement</key><true/>
	<key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

# Ad-hoc signature only (no Developer ID): arm64 binaries must carry one to
# run at all, and lipo drops the per-slice signatures.
codesign --force --sign - "$APP"

ln -s /Applications dist/stage/Applications
DMG="dist/Markuli-${VERSION}-macos-universal.dmg"
hdiutil create -volname Markuli -srcfolder dist/stage -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"

SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$DMG" 2>/dev/null || stat -c%s "$DMG")
echo "binary: $(stat -f%z "$APP/Contents/MacOS/markuli" 2>/dev/null || stat -c%s "$APP/Contents/MacOS/markuli") bytes"
echo "dmg:    ${SIZE} bytes (budget ${MAX_BYTES})"
lipo -info "$APP/Contents/MacOS/markuli"
if [ "$SIZE" -gt "$MAX_BYTES" ]; then
  echo "error: dmg exceeds the 4 MB budget" >&2
  exit 1
fi

scripts/package-windows.ps1::package-win.name: package-windows.ps1
scripts/package-windows.ps1::package-win.source_code:
# Builds the portable Windows zip (markuli.exe).
#   scripts/package-windows.ps1 0.1.0
# Output: dist/Markuli-<version>-windows-x64.zip
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Version)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$MaxBytes = 4MB # spec budget: artifact <= 4 MB

Set-Location (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
cargo build --release --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'cargo build failed' }

Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist/stage | Out-Null
Copy-Item target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/markuli.exe dist/stage/Markuli.exe
$zip = "dist/Markuli-$Version-windows-x64.zip"
Compress-Archive -Path dist/stage/Markuli.exe -DestinationPath $zip

$size = (Get-Item $zip).Length
Write-Host "exe: $((Get-Item dist/stage/Markuli.exe).Length) bytes"
Write-Host "zip: $size bytes (budget $MaxBytes)"
if ($size -gt $MaxBytes) { throw 'zip exceeds the 4 MB budget' }

check:
    name: fmt, clippy, test (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
      - run: cargo test --workspace
